mappings.note: Three word-equations to render as balanced symbolic equations. C 1.3-LO-1 'Writes a balanced chemical equation for a given reaction' is exactly the task; its second clause (physical states) is NOT tested here, which is what separates it from qid:84782. Not C 1.3-LO-2: the item asks the student to balance, never to explain why balancing follows from conservation of mass. Not C 1.2-LO-1: no reaction has to be CLASSIFIED, even though (ii) and (iii) happen to be displacement and double displacement. Its stored concept tag 'Exothermic chemical reactions' does not describe what is asked.

Balanced equations WITH STATE SYMBOLS, so both clauses of C 1.3-LO-1 are tested, unlike qid:84781. C 8.1-LO-1 is cited second because part (i) turns on writing BaSO4 as (s) against NaCl as (aq) -- interpreting the symbol for a precipitate is the step the item is really probing, and that outcome names it. Not C 1.2-LO-1: the reactions are given, not to be identified. Its stored concept tag 'Endothermic reactions' is unrelated to what is asked; neither reaction is described as absorbing heat.
